question: Should this timeline request wait for the metadata-only audit ledger and lifecycle security contract, or should maintainers intentionally scope a narrower ephemeral timeline surface now?
rationale: The user value is clear, but the implementation choice controls persistence, cross-session visibility, authorization, redaction, retention, and whether this duplicates current Activity and trajectory data.

options.title: Build on audit ledger first
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98521 to define durable metadata, redaction, authorization, and query semantics before adding timeline UI/CLI surfaces.

options.title: Approve ephemeral timeline only
options.body: Limit the feature to browser/session-local live events and document that it does not satisfy durable JSON export or historical timelines.

options.title: Decline broad timeline
options.body: Keep Activity and trajectory export as the supported observability paths and narrow or close this issue after documenting that product decision.

recommendation.title: Build on audit ledger first
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98521 to define durable metadata, redaction, authorization, and query semantics before adding timeline UI/CLI surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the related metadata-only audit direction and appears in recent current-main history for adjacent Activity and CLI observability files.
